distribution.narrative: Yin et al. (1984) reported Heilongjiang (Dailing). Huang & Lu (2015) reported Heilongjiang. Literature-based occurrence records; the regional occurrence assessment remains Candidate pending independent review. Alonso-Zarazaga et al. (2023) list Jilin as catalogue-reported mainland Chinese distribution for this taxon. These literature-based distribution records do not change the existing occurrence assessment.

host_note: Hosts are retained at the scientific-name resolution reported in the source, with citations for each host. Repeated listings in the 1984 and 2015 compilations are not treated as independent confirmations; host associations await separate review.
